title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer

$190,000 - $225,000 + 20% bonus

Multiple US Cities (4 days a week in office)

This is an opportunity to join a highly visible innovation team building AI-enabled products that directly influence major investment decisions. You'll work on greenfield technology, partner closely with senior stakeholders, and help shape the future of predictive analytics within a data-rich business environment.

THE COMPANY

They are a large, established organisation operating at significant scale across the United States, with a strong focus on technology, data, and innovation. Their teams are investing heavily in AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics to transform how business decisions are made. The innovation function operates with the agility of a start-up while benefiting from the resources and backing of a large enterprise. You will join a collaborative team of software engineers, data scientists, and AI specialists working on high-impact products used by senior business leaders.

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you will join a high-impact AI and predictive analytics team building a greenfield investment platform, combining Python, React and machine learning to influence multi-billion-dollar business decisions in a start-up environment backed by a major enterprise.

Specifically, you can expect to be involved in the following:

  • Build and enhance a full-stack investment analytics platform used by key business stakeholders.
  • Develop scalable backend services using Python and modern frontend applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Design and implement AI-enabled workflows, tools, and integrations that improve decision-making processes.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and business teams to identify problems and deliver solutions.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and help establish best practices for a growing engineering function.
  • Surface machine learning and predictive analytics insights through intuitive user experiences.
  • Improve development processes, testing frameworks, and deployment pipelines.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment where you can take ownership from concept through to production.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

The successful Software Engineer will have the following skills and experience:

  • Strong commercial experience in full-stack software engineering.
  • Expertise in Python with experience building scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Strong frontend development experience with React, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
  • Experience building production-ready software in start-up, scale-up, fintech, or technology-led environments.
  • Exposure to AI, machine learning, LLM applications, AI agents, or predictive analytics products.
  • Experience delivering greenfield or 0-to-1 product development initiatives.
  • Ability to balance technical excellence with product thinking and business impact.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
  • Exposure to machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, or similar is beneficial.

BENEFITS

The successful Software Engineer will receive the following benefits:

  • Salary between $190,000 - $225,000 - depending on experience
  • Annual bonus of up to 20%

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your resume to Majid Latif via the Apply link on this page.
